/**

 */async function loadJsPDF(){if(window.jspdf)return window.jspdf.jsPDF;return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const script=document.createElement("script");script.src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js";script.onload=()=>resolve(window.jspdf.jsPDF);script.onerror=reject;document.head.appendChild(script);});}export async function downloadReceiptPDF(receipt){const jsPDF=await loadJsPDF();const doc=new jsPDF({unit:"mm",format:"a4"});const W=210;// A4 width mm
const margin=20;let y=0;// ── Helpers ──

doc.setFillColor(76,29,149);// brand purple #4C1D95
rect(0,0,W,42);doc.setTextColor(255,255,255);doc.setFont("helvetica","bold");doc.setFontSize(22);text("MessHub",margin,18);doc.setFont("helvetica","normal");doc.setFontSize(10);text("Mess Management System",margin,26);text("Payment Receipt",margin,33);// Receipt ID top-right
doc.setFontSize(9);const rcpLabel=`Receipt: ${receipt.receiptId||receipt.id||"—"}`;text(rcpLabel,W-margin,18,{align:"right"});text(receipt.date||new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-IN"),W-margin,25,{align:"right"});y=52;// ── Payment Successful badge ──

doc.setTextColor(28,25,23);doc.setFont("helvetica","bold");doc.setFontSize(9);text("PAYMENT DETAILS",margin,y);doc.setDrawColor(109,40,217);doc.setLineWidth(0.8);line(margin,y+2,margin+45,y+2);y+=8;const payRows=[["Plan",receipt.plan||"—"],["Payment Method",receipt.method||"—"],["Transaction Date",receipt.date||"—"],["Status","Paid"]];doc.setFont("helvetica","normal");doc.setFontSize(9);payRows.forEach(_ref2=>{let[label,val]=_ref2;doc.setTextColor(120,116,108);text(label,margin,y);doc.setTextColor(28,25,23);doc.setFont("helvetica","bold");if(label==="Status"){doc.setTextColor(5,150,105);}text(val,margin+55,y);doc.setFont("helvetica","normal");doc.setTextColor(28,25,23);y+=7;});y+=6;// ── Amount breakdown table ──
